description: Scores an API 0-100 for how well AI agents will use it as tools, from its OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 spec: operationIds, summaries, descriptions, parameter descriptions, enums, examples, JSON bodies, response and error schemas, pagination, auth, idempotency and tool count (the Agentify API kit's rules). Give the spec's https URL or the spec itself. Free; returns the score, each rule's result with how to fix it, and the most costly findings. Use it before turning an API into an MCP server or listing it for agents.

spec.description: The OpenAPI document itself, as JSON or YAML text (up to 2 MB). Send url or spec, not both.

url.description: https URL of the OpenAPI document (JSON or YAML), e.g. https://api.example.com/openapi.json

name: check_agent_readiness
title: Check agent readiness
